name: On Holding
thesis: Evaluation thesis: On can compound premium sportswear sales while direct-to-consumer growth, international expansion and product breadth improve operating returns. Q2 2026 reported sales grew 13.5% in CHF and 21.6% at constant currency; DTC reached 45.7% of sales and gross margin reached 65.4%. Management targets at least CHF5.6 billion sales, 65% gross margin and 22% adjusted EBITDA margin in 2029. Those targets require evidence of repeat demand, disciplined distribution and cash returns after store costs, working capital, capital spending and stock compensation. Full-price positioning is a management strategy; zero discounting is not established. APAC and apparel growth support the opportunity, but customer retention, country-level returns and LightSpray unit economics remain unquantified. The $1 billion repurchase is an authorization, not an executed reduction in shares. A position decision remains conditional on a verified source population, attributed forecast assumptions and an adequate margin of safety. Use the explicit five-year cash-rent/SBC model; do not treat adjusted EBITDA as owner cash flow. The saved 9.5% discount rate and 16x terminal default are legacy inputs; the dated reviewed scenario artifact states its own effective rates and terminal assumptions.
key_driver: DTC channel mix expansion, full-price gross margin preservation (>=65%), and APAC/Apparel category scaling

tier_1_kpis.name: Gross Profit Margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Compresses below 60.0% for 2 consecutive quarters (loss of full-price discipline / discounting)

tier_1_kpis.name: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Net Sales Mix
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: DTC growth decelerates below Wholesale growth for 2 consecutive quarters

tier_2_kpis.name: Apparel & Accessories Net Sales YoY (CC)
tier_2_kpis.current: Apparel +56.2% CC (CHF 54.2M); Accessories +102.2% CC (CHF 14.5M) in Q2'26
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Apparel growth slows to footwear rate (<20%) indicating category extension failure

tier_2_kpis.name: Stock-Based Compensation / Revenue
tier_2_kpis.current: 1.4% (CHF 12.2M on CHF 850.3M net sales in Q2'26)

tier_3_kpis.name: Net Working Capital Growth Since Prior Year End
tier_3_kpis.current: CHF635.9M as of June 30, 2026; +11.5% versus CHF570.3M at December 31, 2025. This is not year-over-year growth.
tier_3_kpis.source: 6-K Exhibit 99.2 MD&A, Net Working Capital; June 30, 2026 versus December 31, 2025

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Widespread promotional discounting / markdowns damaging premium brand cachet and gross margin
Wholesale channel channel-stuffing or inventory buildup leading to write-downs
Failure of new sports category entries (Football, Golf) to gain athlete adoption
Key founder or elite talent departures (e.g. Roger Federer, Executive Founder Team)

break_rules.narrative: Gross margin below 60% for two consecutive quarters triggers review of pricing, discounting, channel mix, currency, freight and tariffs. The threshold alone does not establish pricing-power loss.
Constant currency growth below 15% for 2 consecutive quarters indicates brand saturation.
